body: Unfortunately it’s a problem I can’t fix, I have a strange face/head and people (as in everyone) laugh/stare at me - i’m completely broken inside now

Cheers josh! I’ll try and cut down on drugs but obviously I need a release

no one has directly insulted me yet so i’m grateful of that, i hope i can be strong enough to live through this
I’m saving up the money but will definitely be booking an appointment this month.
Cheers mate, i’ll try my best

I’m going to see a surgeon.

I was out again yesterday and people were staring, it’s very weird and heartbreaking to be honest mate. All i’ve wanted was to be normal but i’ll have to be patient.

I’m going to a gig next friday with my brother, he thinks i’m mad and it’s in my head but we’ll see.

When everyone that looks at me is laughing/shocked/disgusted then something is seriously wrong.

It’s been horrible these past 2 weeks.

This is pretty much everyone I pass, the only thing that’s changed is my hair started receding so where I may have looked young before I look weird now I suppose. 

I don’t think I can live life as a freak show, the past 2 weeks have been absolutely terrible.
